product_overview: A constrained MPS/MRP web app that lets planners create master FG plans (batch-based), explode mixed/multi-level BOMs to WIP/RAW, calculate feasible production vs actual stock and lead times, and distribute sub-plans to departments with material consolidation for purchasing.
core_goals: Enable master-plan creation and publish with standardized Plan No and snapshotting (BOM version, stock, open PO/MO, lead time).
Support mixed and multi-level BOM explosion and correct netting (batch-centric) to produce FG demand, WIP demand, RAW requisition and warnings.
Provide department-scoped workbench (inbox) for editable sub-plans and enforced read-only views across departments based on ownership.
Expose consolidated raw-material demand in a Material Control Tower with late-availability tracking and ETA-driven replan triggers.
Enforce policy: compute feasible/partial/backorder quantities instead of permitting blind full confirmations; record overrides and audit trails.

features.name: Authentication + Session
features.description: Username/password login via Supabase auth that issues a signed session cookie and enforces permission-based access to protected routes.
user_flows: Navigate to /login -> Fill username and password -> Click Authenticate to sign in -> Receive signed session cookie with permissions -> Navigate to / -> See application landing page (post-login)
Navigate to / -> If not authenticated redirect to /login -> Fill username and wrong password -> Click Authenticate to sign in -> See authentication error message -> Remain on /login
Navigate to /production-line/bom -> If authenticated but lacking BOM manage permission -> See /unauthorized -> Remain on /production-line/planning (or redirected as configured)

features.name: Master Plan Creation & Publish (Production Planning - Master)
features.description: Create a master FG plan (Plan No, planning period, bucket), run material calculation (explode mixed/multi-level BOMs), review feasibility, and publish a frozen master snapshot which generates sub-plans.
user_flows: Navigate to /production-line/planning/master -> Click Create Master Plan -> Select planning period (start/end date) -> Choose FG products and enter planned batch quantities (Draft) -> Click Run calculation -> Wait for calculation results showing FG Demand, WIP Demand, RAW Requisition and Warnings -> Review feasible/short/backorder values -> Click Publish Master Plan -> POST /api/production-planning/master-publish executes -> See confirmation and master plan snapshot created and sub-plans generated

Navigate to /production-line/planning/master -> Create Master Plan with planned batches -> Click Run calculation -> See material shortages and late-availability warnings -> Attempt to Publish Master Plan -> System shows feasible/partial/backorder summary and blocks full confirm per policy -> Offer options to auto-create backorder or adjust schedule -> User chooses to create backorder and Publish partial (or cancel)

features.name: Department Workbench / Inbox (Production Planning - Workbench/Inbox)
features.description: Department-scoped inbox and workbench where users pull work from a master Plan No, run constrained calculations for their owner SKUs, confirm sub-plans, and see explicit feasible / short / backorder values and earliest material ETA.
user_flows: Navigate to /production-line/planning/inbox -> Filter by Plan No or set scope to 'own' -> See list of plan items with badges indicating Editable or Read-only based on owner -> Open a plan row -> Click Run calculation -> View Feasible Batch, Short Batch, Backorder Batch and Earliest material ETA -> Click Confirm Sub Plan -> POST to /api/production-planning/inbox (confirm) -> See success and plan row status updated to confirmed

Navigate to /production-line/planning/inbox -> Filter to a plan item owned by another department -> Attempt to edit the row -> See Read-only badge and lock tooltip -> Click Confirm Sub Plan -> See permission denied message and/or redirect to /unauthorized -> No changes applied

features.name: Material Control Tower (Production Planning - Control Tower)
features.description: Centralized view for Warehouse/Purchasing/Managers to consolidate RAW demand across sub-plans, surface late-availability and ETA impacts, and trigger replan or expedite actions feeding back to sub-plans.
user_flows: Navigate to /production-line/planning/control-tower -> System loads consolidated RAW demand and late-availability indicators -> Filter by masterPlanNo or date range -> Identify items with ETA beyond planning bucket -> Select affected items and click Trigger Replan -> System recalculates feasible quantities and posts updates to related sub-plans and signals Warehouse/Purchasing

Navigate to /production-line/planning/control-tower -> Filter yields missing ETA or API failure -> See warning 'ETA missing / No scheduled receipts' and list of affected items -> Click Recommend Action -> System shows suggested actions (expedite PO / reassign stock / mark exception) and allow user to create manual PO or mark exception with audit reason

features.name: Production BOM (View + Approval)
features.description: View and manage multi-version BOMs by SKU, review material lines and base_batch data, and approve or reject BOM versions with policy validation enforced prior to approval.
user_flows: Navigate to /production-line/bom -> Search/filter SKUs and BOM statuses -> Open BOM details for a SKU -> Review BOM versions and material lines (including base_batch and base_output_boxes) -> Click Approve version -> POST to relevant approval API -> See approval success and version status updated

Navigate to /production-line/bom -> Search for SKU -> Open BOM details -> Attempt to Approve version while required fields (e.g., base_batch) are missing or policy validation fails -> See validation error specifying missing fields -> Approval blocked until validation is fixed

known_limitations.issue: Test automation is currently XPath/index sensitive; missing permissions can shift sidebar structure and cause misclicks.
known_limitations.impact: End-to-end automation can fail even when functionality is correct if nav visibility differs by role.

known_limitations.issue: Some planning UI flows include dev/test fallbacks (demo rows/optimistic publish) to keep UAT/TestSprite deterministic.
known_limitations.impact: Non-production behavior may differ from production data-driven behavior.
